D10-1034 ①: realname submission read the realname age line from a constant (MIN_REALNAME_AGE = 14, TODO waiting for the config key); B1-02zzf (#2868) registered minor.min_realname_age (config.risk, 14..18, seed 14, BR-ID-26 细则「配置」). realname.ts readMinRealnameAge reads it per app through IDENTITY_CONFIG (content's own connection; after the 20001 check, before the age check; submit opens no transaction): a safe integer 14..18 is used, anything else (no row, read failure, below 14, above 18, non-integer, string, null) is 14 — never looser than 08's value; a read failure still judges the age (no 50001). The fallback warn carries only {app_id, key, reason} (spec-test r1 S2: no ID number or name, pinned in unit tests). Age arithmetic unchanged. Admin realname correction still uses the constant — FU-ADMIN-REALNAME-CORRECTION-MIN-AGE, ledger B1-02zzk (#2881). Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21).
